scope:
Package K2b-2 (KERNEL, last third of the interview kernel; no web): the interview happens IN THE CONVERSATION WINDOW, and the words on screen lose their internal names. Source of truth: docs/architecture/M1_USTAWIENIA_JAKO_GRAF_2026-10-16.md item '### M1-K2' (line ~331: 'loom/src/chat/chat_engine.cpp (send: jesli conversation.metadata.flow == profile.interview -> dispatch do interview handlera zamiast use_model: pytanie asystenta jako wiadomosc assistant, odpowiedz uzytkownika -> ProfileSession::dispatch(answer), po sekcji karta review jako propozycja akcji (ActionProposalBlock) - bez modelu = formularz ...') and docs/reports/INDEX.md 'S1 / M1-K2a', 'S1 / M1-K2a-fix', 'S1 / M1-K2b1' (what exists: loom/src/actions/profile_ops.{h,cpp}, actions profile.interview / profile.show / profile.set / profile.confirm in FORM mode, OnboardingStore::interview_view, chat_ops.pack words, proposals as {action, with, gate}). Branch claude/m1-w0 is at aa45db5b (K2b-1; the tree is clean, the gate k2b1 FINISHED RED - see STEP 0). The owner's rules: nothing is decided for the person; no private data leaves the machine - this package is FORM MODE ONLY, the model path stays refused with a reason (it needs privacy_decision(send) and a cost estimate, a later package); 'declined' never asked again, 'never' respected until reopened; nothing hidden silently; words are DATA (pl + en), no literals in C++.
STEP 0 - FIX THE RED GATE FIRST (it is in K2b-1's work): the local gate k2b1 on aa45db5b failed exactly one ctest: unit.test_chat_ops, loom/tests/test_chat_ops.cpp ~lines 535-555: for EVERY action of chat_coverage.pack the example sentences (pl and en) are sent as chat text and the test expects either an immediate 'executed' (execution.direct actions) or a proposal with status 'pending' carrying receipt_id and run_id; the one hard-coded exception is import.file without a path (status 'unavailable'). For profile.set and profile.confirm (new in K2b-1, both pl and en sentences) the router answers status 'unavailable' (12 failed assertions: the sentences cannot supply the required params - profile.set needs slot+value, profile.confirm needs kind/text/locale/user_id and is a CONTINUATION reached from the proposal that profile.interview returns, not something a person says). Decide and record (data-driven, no new hard-coded action ids in the test): the expectation 'what a sentence alone can do' becomes DATA of the coverage entry (e.g. chat_coverage.pack entry field `chat_outcome`: pending | executed | unavailable | continuation, with a reason in pl+en), the test reads it, and import.file's special case moves into the same data; profile.confirm is declared a continuation (it needs no sentences of its own, and the coverage test that demands sentences for every action must accept the declaration); for profile.set prefer making the sentence REAL if the router can fill slot and value from a natural phrase ('zapamietaj, ze ...' style) - if it cannot be done honestly, declare it 'unavailable' with the reason 'needs a slot and a value that a free sentence does not carry' rather than inventing a parser. Then run the FULL ctest set that the gate runs for the chat area: ctest --preset dev -R 'chat|route|coverage|actions|profile|onboarding' (note: the acceptance regex of K2b-1 did not include 'chat' - that is why this slipped) and make it green BEFORE the rest. The gate also runs the guard 'verify_ctest' on the junit - unit.test_chat_ops was the only failing test; everything else in the 256 was green, so after STEP 0 the K2b-1 work is expected to be gate-green.
BUILD (after STEP 0), commit after each: (1) START IN A CONVERSATION: profile.interview {op:'start'} without conv_id creates a conversation (title from the pack, e.g. 'Poznajmy sie' / 'Getting to know each other') whose metadata.flow = 'profile.interview' and returns its conv_id; with an existing empty conv_id it marks that one; the first assistant message of that conversation is the level question with the three previews (the same text profile.interview start returns). (2) THE SEND BRANCH: in ChatEngine::send (loom/src/chat/chat_engine.cpp ~line 1671; the file is large - grep, do not read it all; there is already a path that routes a user message to an action and stores metadata.routed / action_proposal / action_run, see ~line 727 and loom/src/actions/route.cpp - reuse that mechanism and its message shapes instead of a parallel one): when the conversation's metadata.flow == 'profile.interview' the user's text does NOT go to the model; it is stored as the user message and answered by the interview handler: the answer to the pending question (profile.interview op answer with the pending slot - keep the pending slot in the conversation metadata or derive it from plan(); decide and record), or a remark ('nie pytaj o zdrowie') -> an assistant message with the 'Tak zrozumialem ...' lines and an ACTION PROPOSAL (confirm/decline) stored the way agent.run proposals are stored so the existing web ActionProposalBlock can render it later; the next question as an assistant message; at the end of a section the review card as a proposal. The ordinary conversation is untouched: a conversation without that flow behaves byte-identically (loom/tests/fixtures/golden/chat_request_legacy.json stays untouched; there is a test that the legacy request body is unchanged). Cost/limits: no model call, so no usage ledger entry is made, but the answer says 'bez modelu, nic nie wyszlo poza to urzadzenie' in the first message only. (3) PER-CATEGORY LEVELS + OLD STORES: pass profile_detail_by_category from the setting into plan() (K2b-1 passes {}), and wire the explicit refresh of an old stored scenario (a store created before K2a answers Unsupported today - add the explicit update path through OnboardingStore::update_pack that the person confirms, as a proposal; never automatic). (4) NO INTERNAL NAMES ON SCREEN (my critique of K2b-1's answers): visible sentences contain things like 'Minimalnie (minimal)', 'ustawieniu profile_detail_level', 'erase=true', 'akcja profile.confirm prosi o Twoja zgode' - rewrite the visible sentences in chat_ops.pack pl+en as plain words (the level names without the id in brackets, 'w ustawieniach' instead of the key, 'potwierdz, zeby usunac' instead of erase=true); the ids stay in the structured data fields. Grep the new words for [a-z]+_[a-z]+ keys, dotted ids and 'true'/'false' tokens in the visible strings and make the test fail on them (a data-driven test over the pl and en sentences of the profile words). (5) TESTS (doctest; mock model/transport that fails the test if called): a conversation started by profile.interview start -> user text '...minimalnie' -> assistant asks one of the minimal questions; user text 'nie pytaj o zdrowie' -> assistant proposal, nothing written, after confirm the category is never; an ordinary conversation in the same database is unaffected and DOES reach the (fake) model; messages are persisted and the history reads back in order; the legacy request golden unchanged; ASAN pitfall rules; the new words test above. Registry chain if a route literal appears (python3 loom/tools/gen_graph_interfaces.py -> gen_runtime_profiles.py (then --check) -> re-pin sha256 of graph/interfaces.pack in data_domains.pack -> ctest -R 'graph_entry|kb_pack|kb_data_domains|runtime_profile|onboarding_pack|graph_proj'); regenerate runtime_profiles_embedded.inc when actions.pack/chat_ops.pack change.
DECISIONS ARE YOURS (R1-R53): record each with how to reverse under 'S1 / M1-K2b2' in docs/reports/INDEX.md. Do NOT touch loom/android/smoke/*, loom/web (next: W2), the golden chat_request_legacy.json, the receipt schema. If after about 70 tool calls a piece is unfinished, commit what is consistent and return done=false with exactly what is left.
accept: cmake --build --preset dev (background, polled) succeeds; ctest --preset dev -R 'onboarding|profile|chat|route|coverage|actions|runtime_profile|kb_pack|kb_data_domains|graph_entry|abi_compat|compat' green INCLUDING unit.test_chat_ops (paste its summary line; the chat tests include the legacy golden); gen_runtime_profiles.py --check clean; python3 /home/user/chatadhd/tools/clang_inc_check.py loom/build/dev all ok; python3 /home/user/chatadhd/tools/lint_asan_range_for.py aa45db5b shows 0 suspicious lines; pushed to origin claude/m1-w0. The card pastes: the transcript of a short interview conversation in pl (assistant/user messages as stored: level question, answer, next question, remark with proposal, confirm), the proof that an ordinary conversation still reaches the fake model, the rewritten sentences before/after, the decision about where the pending slot lives, and exactly what is left for W2 (web) and for the model path.
rules_extra: Shared machine: never kill processes by name; record the pid/port you started. Do NOT run the full gate (S1 does). CACHE RULE: no single tool call longer than ~4 minutes - run builds and tests in the background and poll with short calls. One native build at a time (loom/build/dev of this worktree). Keep context small: grep and line ranges, never dump big files (chat_engine.cpp is huge). ASAN pitfall: never range-for over .at()/.value()/operator[] of a by-value temporary - bind to a named const first. Generated *.inc data keeps explicit lengths. Tests must not depend on speed or order. Private data: synthetic data only; never read docs/exports or eval/real-holdout-key. Texts for the owner in plain Polish and English; nothing described as working that is only planned.
